About The Role
We are looking for a dynamic AI & Software Engineer to join our Transformation & AI team. This role is ideal for someone passionate about bringing the power of AI into real-world business problems.
You will be responsible for leading the implementation of AI solutions using Microsoft’s Azure ecosystem, including Azure OpenAI, Copilot frameworks, and Microsoft 365 integrations. The ideal candidate is hands-on, thrives in ambiguity, and can rapidly translate business challenges into technical solutions, excited about prototyping AI agents, building quick PoCs, and shaping strategic AI initiatives.
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of AI solutions using Azure AI services, including Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, and Microsoft Copilot SDKs.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven transformation across back-office operations.
  • Build, test, and iterate on proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and pilots that solve real business problems quickly.
  • Integrate AI agents and copilots into existing business workflows using Microsoft Power Platform, Graph API, and Teams/365 ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with business and software engineering teams to productionize successful PoCs and ensure adherence to full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
  • Stay on top of the evolving AI/ML landscape, especially within Microsoft’s AI ecosystem, and bring new ideas into the organization.
Qualifications
  • English and Portuguese fluency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in software development, with focused on AI/ML solutions.
  • Proven experience with Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, Azure ML).
  • Hands-on experience building copilots or intelligent agents using Microsoft 365 Copilot SDK, Teams Toolkit, Azure AI Foundry, and/or Power Platform.
  • Hands-on experience on Azure Cloud Services such as FunctionApps, LogicApps, AppServices, and CosmosDB.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience working within Agile SDLC processes, with a deep understanding of best practices for scalable software delivery.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines on Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • UI/UX skills – HTML, JavaScript. Integrating AI bots into web portals.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce integration and RPA tools – UI Path, Power Automate etc.
Preferred Skills
  • Azure cloud certification.
  • Experience with Power Automate and familiarity with Process Automation tools.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Azure Cognitive Search, Pinecone, or Qdrant).
  • Knowledge and/or experience with LLM frameworks for building Agentic AI like - LangChain, CrewAI, n8n etc.
  • Experience integrating LLMs into business process workflows and chat-based UI (Teams, Power Apps, etc.).
  • Exposure to enterprise business processes in operations, finance, HR, or legal functions.
  • Prior experience in building citizen-developer enablement or AI CoE initiatives is a strong plus.
Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world stronger, safer, and smarter. We accelerate transformation across a broad range of applications including environmental, health and safety compliance, industrial condition monitoring, next-generation product design, and healthcare safety solutions.

Our forward-looking companies lead the way in software-powered workflow solutions, data-driven intelligence, AI-powered automation, and other disruptive technologies. title: Test Lead
description:
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a full-time Test Lead for our new testing group in Brazil. The person in this role will hire, develop, and lead a group of testers to own the testing approach on one of our development teams within a major Epic product. They will both develop new processes and work within existing efforts to ensure our software as a service products continue to be delivered at an appropriate quality bar for our users. They will be ultimately accountable for supervising test teams, providing individuals with mentorship and career development, all the while balancing workloads from multiple sources. If you are comfortable in a fast-paced environment, capable of navigating interpersonal quandaries, and have the desire to develop world-class QA talent, then we would love to talk to you.

In this role, you will

Shepherd testing process for their assigned Project, supervising day-to-day tasking of up to 15 testers.

Set expectations for Testers; mentor, develop, and evaluate testers on their performance and growth plans.

Prioritize testing to meet development deadlines, communicate the status of testing to stakeholders, and escalate issues to the right owners so major issues are visible and handled promptly.

Ensures their team maintains the company standard for bug quality and test execution and improves team processes through feedback.

Troubleshooting system and hardware issues in order to unblock testing.

Able to perform test gap analysis and communicate this information to QA Analysts and /or QA leads, and communicate with multiple parties to facilitate the flow of information from dev teams to test teams.

What we're looking for

3+ years of testing experience in fast-paced environments, with the ability to juggle multiple projects at once.

1+ year(s) of professional leadership experience.

3+ months of professional management experience.

Solid understanding of test methodologies, including functional, qualitative, and performance against consistently iterative development.

Strong communication skills and ability to confidently collaborate with product owners and developers on technical topics and features.

Excellent reporting skills for assembling data in an easily digestible format.

Test Planning skills for projecting test coverage needs in advance while remaining flexible to cover urgent requests.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro-services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and Charmhub.io marketplaces, behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.
This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.
We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.
This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.
Location : This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.
What your day will look like

  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMER - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Pipeline Developer to join the Special Projects team to help us improve efficiency and build scalable creative production tool sets around UE. This role will have a particular focus on building out Machine Learning, AI, and Cloud-Based workflows and infrastructure to support emerging creative experiences. This is an exciting moment for technology and for creators, and the role offers the opportunity to participate in the building of vital systems that bind the engine with cloud and AI. We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about supporting teams and developing tools and workflows across one or more disciplines, are excited about emerging technology, and designing systems to help that technology be harnessed by creators. They should be able to communicate with various departments and teams to ensure that any pipeline we build is done so in close collaboration with the many other talented teams at Epic Games across the organization. Candidates should have a strong understanding of production needs and artist workflows - this role requires a clear understanding of how technology can be used to craft creative experiences, and successful candidates should have a passion for building tools for creators.

In this role, you will

Build best-in-class production workflow tooling and automation

Scope out and drive production programming initiatives, working closely with other developers and stakeholders toward scalable, maintainable solutions

Deliver practical, forward-thinking solutions that address the needs of the team while working with production to balance development priorities and timelines

Promote and demonstrate development progress to relevant stakeholders

Exhibit a passion for learning and staying current with emerging machine learning technology and developments

What we're looking for

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science/Programming, or relevant industry experience, with a strong foundation in software design patterns and object-oriented programming

5+ years experience as a Pipeline Developer, Technical Artist, or similar, working on production in games, feature animation, VFX, or related industry

Experience integrating and maintaining custom tools in 3rd-party software ( eg, with Python )

Familiarity with current & emerging ML technologies and development environments, and demonstrable experience in building and/or experimenting in the space

Comfort level in working with platforms such as Azure, GCP/Vertex, AWS/Bedrock, Gradio etc, and awareness of analytics and tracking platforms like Databricks & Grafana

High attention to detail, proactive problem solver with excellent communication skills, and an ability to multitask effectively

Bonus for experience in one or more of the following areas: Unreal Engine, C++, USD & OpenSource/Standards, ShotGrid/Flow Toolkit, Asset Management, Virtual Production

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

About the company

We develop cutting-edge games and cross-platform game engine technology!

Founded in 1991, Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment company and provider of 3D engine technology. Epic operates Fortnite, the world’s largest game with over 350 million accounts and 2.5 billion friend connections. Epic also develops Unreal Engine, which powers the world’s leading games and is being adopted across industries such as film and television, architecture, automotive, and manufacturing for visualization and simulation. Epic has over 2,200 employees across 35 offices worldwide with headquarters in Cary, North Carolina.

Coordenador de Gestão de Contas Chave, Brazil Retail / Varejo Brasil

Job ID: | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras e é uma posição de contribuidor individual.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho. Atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. Estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com o objetivo de sermos "a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo". Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI.

Strategic Vendor Services (SVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parcerias estratégicas a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. Nesta posição comercial, como especialista de contas chave na equipe SVS, você ganhará exposição de 360 graus em todas as áreas do e-commerce, sendo responsável por todo o relacionamento com suas marcas e aconselhando seus principais parceiros de gerenciamento de contas com seu conhecimento de negócio. Você definirá e implementará planos de ação sob medida para impulsionar o desempenho de suas marcas, monitorar as métricas de sucesso diariamente e garantir que a experiência da marca no serviço SVS esteja no mais alto nível. Você irá colaborar com as principais funções de varejo, como Vendor Managers, InStock Managers, Finanças e Category Marketing Managers.

Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de alta complexidade, trabalhando com autonomia para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de médio a alto impacto, atingindo especialistas de contas chave SVS em várias categorias de produtos e implementando melhorias de processos escaláveis para todo o varejo da Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Aconselhamento de Negócios:

  1. Identificar oportunidades analisando dados, fornecer recomendações para melhorar as vendas com sustentabilidade e maximizar a lucratividade e crescimento do negócio a longo prazo da Amazon e do parceiro;
  2. Gerir relacionamento com parceiros de ponta a ponta;
  3. Analisar financeiramente oportunidades para atender/superar metas de receita/lucro para seus fornecedores.

Seleção de Produtos:
  1. Facilitar o aumento do catálogo gerenciando novos lançamentos, melhorando a descoberta/navegação;
  2. Negociar e garantir produtos das marcas mais relevantes na Amazon.

Disponibilidade de Produto:
  1. Garantir disponibilidade dos produtos aos clientes ao trabalhar com um Especialista de Supply Chain para impulsionar a excelência operacional.

Tráfego:
  1. Recomendar campanhas de marketing/publicidade das marcas promovendo lançamentos/aumentando tráfego ou conversão.

Conversão:
  1. Planejar e implementar promoções, melhorar a jornada do cliente da Amazon;
  2. Negociar e garantir financiamento de iniciativas de marketing;
  3. Ter compreensão completa da indústria, sazonalidades, tendências/eventos globais.

Temos vagas em aberto em diversas categorias de produtos como Mercearia, Calçados, Escritório, Cozinha, Esportes, Livros entre outras.

Requisitos Mínimos:
- Bacharelado/Licenciatura;
- Forte habilidade de comunicação escrita e verbal;
- Forte habilidade em análises quantitativas/analíticas;
- Experiência sólida na área comercial, e-commerce e/ou varejo;
- Comunicação escrita e verbal avançada em Inglês;
- Experiência com gestão de público de diversos níveis e influência de pessoas;
- Experiência com SQL;
- Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, QlikSense, Power BI, Tableau);
- Experiência com gestão de pessoas/times;
- Experiência com análises financeiras/qualitativas, planejamento de inventário, gerenciamento de produto/projeto.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a entregar os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Se você tem uma deficiência e precisa de uma acomodação ou ajuste no local de trabalho durante o processo de aplicação e contratação, por favor visite para mais informações.

Située au coeur de l’Essonne, entre ville et campagne, Brétigny-sur-Orge (27 000 habitants) est accessible par la ligne C du R.E.R. Reconnue pour ses efforts en matière de transition écologique, Brétigny est la première ville de France labellisée « Ville Durable et Innovante ». Commune dynamique, porteuse de projets ambitieux, elle est membre de la Communauté d’Agglomération Coeur d’Essonne (200 000 hab.).
RECRUTE
Adjoint au Chef de Service Enfance (F/H)
Cadre d’emploi des rédacteurs territoriaux ou des attachés territoriaux (Titulaire ou contractuel)
VOS MISSIONS

  • Encadrement et coordination des équipes des secteurs Animation et Scolaire Supervision des responsables de secteurs, animation des réunions d’équipe, appui à la gestion RH (plannings, remplacements, entretiens, évaluations). Coordination des activités, application des consignes de sécurité, et animation du dialogue social de proximité.

Participation active à la préparation de la rentrée scolaire, aux ajustements liés aux effectifs scolaires et aux besoins des familles
  • Suivi budgétaire et gestion comptable Participation à l’élaboration des budgets prévisionnels des secteurs, suivi des engagements et des dépenses, contrôle de la bonne exécution financière des prestations. Collaboration étroite avec le service administratif et financier de la direction enfance jeunesse (DEJ)
  • Participation à la gestion des marchés publics Appui au chef de service pour les marchés liés aux prestations enfance (restauration, fournitures, activités). Suivi de l’exécution des marchés

En plus des missions listées ci-dessus, l’agent pourra être amené à participer à l’activité du service et de la direction, selon les nécessités, en réalisant d’autres missions.

Vous avez des connaissances des secteurs scolaire et périscolaire, vous maîtrisez les techniques de communication et outils bureautiques. Vous savez prioriser les informations, les tâches et gérer les situations conflictuelles.
Disponible et rigoureux, vous avez le sens de la diplomatie et de la discrétion.
Vous êtes reconnu pour vos qualités rédactionnelles, vous avez une aptitude pour la médiation et aimez travailler en équipe. Vous avez le sens du service public, êtes force de proposition. Vous savez être autonome. Vous êtes rigoureux, méthodique, organisé. Vous savez vous adapter aux situations, prioriser et agir. Vos facilités relationnelles vous permettent de travailler en transversalité, de renseigner et conseiller les services municipaux. Une appétence pour les chiffres serait appréciable.

Déplacements sur le territoire de la commune.
Disponibilité sur le temps du midi et en fin de journée.

title: Evento do PL Minas mexe com aspirações de políticos de Divinópolis
description:
Evento do PL Minas mexe com aspirações de políticos de Divinópolis

Falta mais de um ano para as Eleições 2026, mas partidos já discutem nomes e alianças para candidaturas. Representantes de Divinópolis em Brasília, o deputado federal Domingos Sávio (PL) e o senador Cleitinho (Republicanos) são pré-candidatos ao Senado e ao Governo de Minas, respectivamente. Porém, articulações recentes podem afetar essas aspirações.

Na última quinta-feira (26), o Partido Liberal realizou um encontro estadual em Belo Horizonte, com a presença do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro. Um nome que chamou atenção foi o do vice-governador Mateus Simões (Novo), que é tratado por Romeu Zema como seu sucessor , já que o atual chefe do Executivo está no segundo mandato.

Apesar da aproximação com Bolsonaro, principalmente na campanha que o elegeu ao Senado, o divinopolitano não participou do evento.

Em nota enviada ao Portal MPA , a assessoria de Domingos Sávio afirmou que ele esteve em compromissos em Águas Claras, distrito de Mariana. Sobre a pretensão de disputar o Governo de Minas, Cleitinho mantém a postura de pré-candidato, mas o foco está em seu mandato de senador, e ele declarou que “só vai tocar no assunto no ano que vem ”.

Pré-candidato ‘forasteiro’ teria ‘desaprovação’ do PL Divinópolis

Em 2026, eleitores irão escolher dois nomes ao Senado Federal. Uma pesquisa divulgada pelo Instituto Veritá em março aponta que o PL tem três nomes tecnicamente empatados: o deputado federal e presidente estadual do partido, Domingos Sávio, o deputado federal Eros Biondini e o deputado estadual Cristiano Caporezzo.

Na ocasião, Domingos Sávio afirmou que sua prioridade atual é o trabalho na Câmara e a construção de um projeto político sólido para Minas.

Recentemente, outros nomes foram ventilados, como o pastor Edésio de Oliveira, pai do deputado Nikolas Ferreira, e o comentarista político Marco Antônio Costa, conhecido como ‘Superman da Direita’ , que se mudou de São Paulo para Lagoa Santa. Contudo, o partido não pretende lançar um ‘forasteiro’ como candidato.

Em uma postagem no Instagram sobre uma possível candidatura, o perfil do PL Divinópolis comentou que “vai rolar não ”, indicando uma possível rejeição.

Ao Portal MPA , a assessoria de Domingos Sávio afirmou que o deputado “não tem controle sobre perfis de redes sociais isolados ” e que não procede a informação de que Marco Antônio seja pré-candidato ao Senado. Além disso, o PL Minas reforça que “não há nenhuma sinalização de ter candidato que não seja do estado ”.

Docente Publicidade e Propaganda | UNIDEP

Job type: Full-time employee

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na área de Graduação , especificamente no Centro Universitário de Pato Branco/UNIDEP , para trabalhar de forma presencial na cidade de Pato Branco / PR .

O UNIDEP atualmente oferece 16 cursos de graduação em diversas áreas do conhecimento, além de cursos de pós-graduação. A instituição dispõe de uma das infraestruturas de ensino mais completas do Estado do Paraná. Saiba mais em: .

Ao assumir o cargo de Docente de Publicidade e Propaganda no UNIDEP , seu objetivo principal será atuar de forma estratégica e colaborativa na elaboração, atualização e desenvolvimento dos Projetos Pedagógicos de Curso, assegurando sua coerência com as diretrizes legais, os princípios institucionais e as demandas acadêmicas, contribuindo para a excelência dos processos formativos e para a prática pedagógica inovadora e de qualidade.

Esta é uma VAGA EXCLUSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA

Consideramos neste processo seletivo candidaturas de pessoas com alguma deficiência comprovada pelo CID . Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e estamos comprometidos em promover a representatividade em todas as áreas da empresa.

  • Desenvolvimento e Ministração de Aulas: Criar e ministrar aulas dinâmicas e interativas, utilizando métodos pedagógicos atualizados e inovadores.
  • Planejamento Curricular: Elaborar e revisar planos de ensino e programas de disciplinas, garantindo a integração de objetivos acadêmicos e alinhamento com as diretrizes do curso.
  • Avaliação e Feedback: Projetar, aplicar e corrigir avaliações, fornecendo feedback detalhado e construtivo para promover o desenvolvimento dos alunos.
  • Orientação Acadêmica: Oferecer orientação individualizada para alunos, auxiliando no planejamento de carreiras e na resolução de dificuldades acadêmicas.
  • Desenvolvimento de Materiais Didáticos: Criar e atualizar materiais como apostilas, apresentações e recursos online para enriquecer o processo de ensino-aprendizagem.
  • Colaboração e Trabalho em Equipe: Trabalhar com colegas e outros profissionais para promover um ambiente educacional integrado.

O que buscamos (não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Graduação em Comunicação Social, com habilitações em Cinema, Design, Fotografia, Jornalismo, Publicidade e Propaganda ou Letras. O diploma deve ser emitido por instituição brasileira oficial ou, se estrangeira, revalidado pelas autoridades brasileiras.
  • Titulação mínima compatível com a vaga, com certificado conforme a Resolução CNE/CES Nº 1/2001.
  • Domínio dos temas da disciplina, capacidade de realizar atividades de ensino de forma independente e colaborativa.
  • Disponibilidade de horário conforme oferta da disciplina.
  • Experiência prévia no ensino superior, pesquisa e publicação.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e revisão de currículos e materiais didáticos, com capacidade de implementar inovações pedagógicas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, para engajar e motivar alunos de diferentes origens.
  • Experiência comprovada em trabalho colaborativo e ambientes acadêmicos dinâmicos.
  • Habilidades de planejamento, organização e uso de ferramentas de gestão acadêmica e pacote Microsoft Office.

Gente é o melhor da gente, por isso oferecemos benefícios e parcerias:

Remuneração:

  • Valor da hora/aula de R$29,98, mais adicionais.
  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações para saúde da mamãe e do bebê, com rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada em educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência).

Desenvolvimento e aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades da Afya.

Sobre a Afya:

Maior hub de educação e tecnologias para a prática médica no Brasil. Fundada em 2019, originou-se da união entre a NRE Educacional e a MEDCEL, com mais de 30 unidades pelo Brasil e mais de 10 startups de soluções digitais para a prática médica, como Afya Whitebook e Afya iClinic. Acesse afya.com.br para saber mais.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto na Nasdaq e na B3. Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia, contando com uma equipe de 10 mil pessoas unidas pelo mesmo objetivo. Se você se identifica, venha transformar a saúde conosco. #VemSerAfya

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade. Aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, exploramos novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para todos. Descrizione dell'azienda

Siram Veolia I&B, società del Gruppo Siram presente in Italia da oltre trent’anni, si rivolge almercato privato dell’Industria e del Real Estate , affiancando i propri clienti e accompagnandoli in un percorso di crescita e sviluppo sostenibile, ottimizzando l'utilizzo delle risorse naturali e impiegando al meglio i propri asset grazie a soluzioni innovative di manutenzione.

In particolare Siram Veolia I&B offreservizi di manutenzione per impianti generali e produttivi rivolti ad un aumento dell'uptime della produzione; progetti di efficientamento energetico degli impianti, edifici e infrastrutture; assistenza e gestione della strumentazione a supporto della produzione tramite laboratori metrologici e servizi di taratura e riparazione; servizi di ingegneria della manutenzione, smart maintenance, reverse engineering, controlli non distruttivi, misure laser/scanner. La diffusa presenza sul territorio nazionale ci consente un presidio costante e una tempestiva assistenza alle aziende clienti, anche nelle situazioni di emergenza.

Descrizione del lavoro

La risorsa che stiamo cercando si occuperà della gestione e coordinamento di progetti per la realizzazione di impianti di trattamento acque per l'area Nord .E

Sono richieste le seguenti capacità:

  • Pianificazione, gestione e controllo di progetti complessi nel settore del trattamento acque

  • Controllo dei tempi, gestione del budget e controllo dei costi

  • Supervisione delle fasi di progettazione, realizzazione e messa in servizio degli impianti

  • Coordinamento delle risorse tecniche e del team di progetto

  • Interfaccia con clienti, fornitori e stakeholder

  • Gestione della documentazione tecnica e amministrativa

  • Supportare l’ufficio acquisti per l’approvvigionamento dei materiali di commessa più rilevanti, sia collaborando alla definizione delle condizioni contrattuali che mantenendo gli opportuni contatti con i fornitori

  • Condurre riunioni periodiche per verificare l’allineamento con le previsioni fatte in merito all’avanzamento dei progetti

  • Redigere relazioni di chiusura commessa, al fine di capitalizzare e diffondere i risultati, soluzioni e quant’altro necessario per incrementare efficacia ed efficienza in esperienze successive

  • Gestire eventuali problematiche che dovessero insorgere durante lo sviluppo dei progetti

Qualifiche

  • Diploma tecnico o laurea in ingegneria

  • Esperienza minima di 5 anni in ruoli analoghi

  • Conoscenza approfondita dei processi di trattamento acque

  • Competenze in project management e certificazione PMP (preferibile)

  • Capacità di sviluppare e sostenere nel tempo rapporti con i clienti e i fornitori coinvolti nei progetti, sia al fine di creare nuove opportunità di business che al fine di proiettare una positiva immagine aziendale

  • Ottima conoscenza degli strumenti informatici

  • Capacità di leadership e problem solving

  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese

  • Disponibilità a brevi trasferte sul territorio italiano

Informazioni aggiuntive

  • buone doti relazionali e predisposizione al lavoro di squadra

FAO’s commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations.


Organizational Setting

In April 2025, the Multi-Partner Trust Fund (MPTF) for the Sustainable Development of the Brazilian Legal Amazon approved the UNJP/BRA/097/UNJ project "Environmental Regularization Project through Land Governance and Territorial Planning, as a pillar for Sustainable Development / Land for Women Project". The intervention was conceived by the Institute of Colonization and Lands of Maranhão (ITERMA) and will have the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) as the executing agency.
The "Land for Women" project aims to promote land and environmental regularization in settlement areas and rural communities in Maranhão, with a priority focus on women heads of household. Seeking to reduce social inequalities, expand territorial governance and promote sustainable agricultural practices, the intervention will combine land titling actions, training in sustainable practices and entrepreneurship, access to credit and environmental monitoring, with a view to ensuring land tenure security, promoting access to public policies and strengthening economic autonomy.

The project is organized into three project components/deliverables, namely:
•Formalization of women's lands in rural and traditional communities.
•Training in bioeconomy practices, sustainable management and female entrepreneurship.
•Technical capacity of the Governments of Maranhão and Pará for land monitoring and environmental enforcement strengthened.


Reporting Lines

The Project Assistant will work under the overall supervision of the Assistant to the Representative for the FAO Programme Unit in Brazil and under the technical guidance of the MPTF Project Coordinator.


Technical Focus

The Project Assistant will support the implementation of the “Environmental Regularization Project through Land Governance and Territorial Planning, as a Pillar for Sustainable Development / Land for Women Project”, ensuring that activities are executed in accordance with the agreed Project Document (ProDoc), workplans and budget.


Tasks and Responsibilities

•Support the preparation of progress reports, work plans, financial reports or other documents required for Project accountability.
•Support the timely implementation of the project activities in accordance with FAO and MPTF rules and procedures,
•Directly assist the monitoring and updating of the project work, procurement, human resources and travel plans.
•Liaise with the project coordinator and other team members to support the organization, participate, make records and take necessary follow-up actions, in technical and operational meetings, and other events.
•As requested by the MPTF Project Coordinator, organize project information and electronic documents in FAO systems, keeping them properly updated.
•Support the preparation of Terms of Reference (ToR) for the processes of acquisition of goods and materials and contracting services, according to FAO rules and procedures.
•Monitor the delivery times of the products of the contracted services (companies and personnel) and verify that equipment and materials meet the required specifications.
•Prepare travel requests, in accordance with FAO rules and procedures, aiming at the timely execution of project activities.
•Assist with other project requests, if asked by supervisor.
•Travel to project sites, if required.


CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING:


Minimum Requirements

•Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Accounting, Agrarian Sciences, Social Sciences or other similar areas.
•At least three years of experience with the implementation of technical cooperation projects in Brazil related to the following areas: family farming, sustainable rural development, promotion of sustainable value chains, and/or land governance.
•Working knowledge (level C) of English and/or Spanish.
•Brazilian nationality.

title: Messaging Operations Manager
description:
Before jumping in on all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

We are Insider, a B2B SaaS company that drives growth for its clients around the world. How are we achieving this? We are the #1 AI-native platform for Customer Experience and Marketing—offers marketers a single platform to deliver unique experiences per person, drive profitable growth, and unleash peak productivity and efficiency. Our platform connects data across channels, predicts future behavior with AI, and individualizes experiences from a single platform.

We have just celebrated our $500M Series E funding round, led by General Atlantic . Before this, we’ve unlocked unicorn status following our Series D round. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 1200+ brands from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Coca-Cola, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Virgin, Nestle, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Dominos, CNN, and the list goes on.

Having unlocked unicorn status, Insider was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world, to achieve $200M in CARR (Committed Annual Recurring Revenue). Insider was named a leader in The Forrester Wave for Cross-Channel Campaign Management 2021, and Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omnichannel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023 Assessment. The company has been recognized in The Top 1% of all software companies worldwide in G2’s 2024 Software Awards , and named in The Top 10 Best Software Products with the most #1 rankings alongside other software legends like Google, Zoom, and Monday.com . According to G2’s Spring’24 reports. Insider is also the #1 G2 Leader in 6+ categories , including Customer Data Platforms (CDP), Personalization Engines, Personalization Software, Mobile Marketing, Customer Journey Analytics, and e-commerce Personalization.

When our team founded Insider, they not only sought to create a product company but also to build the most socially progressive technology community in the world. Through our corporate social responsibility initiatives like 100Projects SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact into our communities across 27+ countries, spearheading transformative projects in areas such as health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing the proportional representation of women in STEM careers.

Behind all these achievements, there is an exceptionally talented and passionate team across 27+ countries that moves fast and agile, creates cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to join us on this journey, just keep reading.

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced individual to join Insider and support our Revenue Operations team as a Messaging Operations Manager , specifically focusing on our messaging and WhatsApp products. In this role, you will play a crucial part in driving profits, optimizing deal execution, and managing vendor negotiations.

You will be responsible for pricing checks, negotiating special pricing with vendors, and collaborating closely with the sales team to ensure smooth deal execution. Your expertise in vendor management and pricing will be vital for the success of the messaging and WhatsApp product lines.

Additionally, you will drive process enhancements and ensure that our pricing and deal structuring align with the company’s overall goals. Your negotiation skills will help maintain a seamless process from quoting to deal closure, while ensuring compliance with both internal policies and external regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

Vendor Negotiation and Pricing Management:

Lead pricing checks and negotiate special pricing with SMS and WhatsApp vendors.

Secure competitive pricing from vendors, ensuring profitability and operational efficiency.

Work closely with the sales team to collaborate on pricing, deal structuring, and contract terms.

Manage vendor relationships to maintain favorable terms and high service levels.

Deal Execution and Rev Ops Collaboration:

Support the Revenue Operations team in driving profitability and optimizing deal execution.

Ensure compliance with internal booking policies and external regulations during deal structuring.

Collaborate with sales teams and other key stakeholders to ensure smooth deal execution.

Assist in onboarding new sales reps and providing training on quoting tools and CRM systems.

Operational Efficiency and Process Enhancements:

Implement and manage dashboards or reporting tools to monitor deal performance, pricing efficiency, and vendor relationships.

Drive process improvements that enhance the team’s scalability and efficiency.

Monitor key metrics related to pricing performance, deal closure rates, and vendor management.

Market & Trend Analysis:

Analyze market trends to ensure that pricing remains competitive across different regions.

Provide insights on SMS and WhatsApp pricing dynamics to inform strategic decisions.

Stay up to date on industry benchmarks to ensure Insider maintains its competitive edge.

Qualifications:

2-8 years of experience in deal desk operations, pricing, or related areas.

Strong negotiation and people skills with a proven track record of vendor management.

Familiarity with CRM systems and quoting tools.

Experience with messaging and WhatsApp products is a plus

Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, capable of managing tight deadlines.



We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

  • 2-5 years of experience in strategic planning or related role within Digital, Direct marketing/ CRM agency or consulting

description:
leadership agility

At Bacardi we care deeply about finding brilliant talent who can bring the following personal attributes to help elevate our 3Fs: Fearless, Family, Founder culture to the next level.

  • Belonging: You have a strong capacity to create a culture of ‘Belonging’, where people feel appreciated for who they are, what they do, and who they can become
  • Self-Awareness: You have high levels of self-awareness, are reflective and know yourself well, understanding both your own strengths and weaknesses and your impact on others
  • People Agility: You bring a deep ability to understand and relate to people and navigate through tough situations to harness and multiply collective performance
  • Results Agility: You demonstrate consistent delivery of results in first-time situations by inspiring teams, exhibiting a presence that builds confidence in yourself and others.
  • Mental Agility: You can think critically to penetrate complex problems and expand the possibilities by making fresh connections. You think strategically whilst being execution focused and bring creativity to the challenges you’re presented with
  • Change Agility: You have a deep natural curiosity, desire to experiment and ability to effectively deal with the heat of change. You have a growth and learning mindset: ready to test, stumble, learn and apply from experience

Disclaimer: Bacardi seeks talent from all backgrounds to bring diversity of thought, agility and capability to our organization across the globe. We promote a working environment where all employees are treated and rewarded fairly. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination that adversely affects individuals or groups on the basis of national origin, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, and any other legally protected aspect of a person's identity.

At Bacardi, we are committed to providing our Primos (employees) with a comprehensive Total Rewards package of compensation, benefits, incentives, allowances, well-being, and much more to meet the needs of themselves and their families. It goes beyond just Cash! The total rewards program is based on pay for performance, whereby the incentive programs are linked to company and individual performance.

Compensation, Paid Time Off & Retirement

  • Competitive Pay Package
  • Competitive Holiday/Paid Time Off, plus additional days offered ( i.e., volunteer day, allowing you to give back to the community)
  • Retirement/Pension Plan
  • Medical, Critical Illness, and Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Best-in-class, family-friendly, and inclusive leave policies

Additional Benefits

  • Flexible work arrangements (depending on role/office/site location)
  • Access to E-learning Platforms and Career Development programs
  • Travel Discounts ( i.e., hotel and car rental)
  • And much more!

The benefits /perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Bacardi, your work location, and are subject to change.

Some benefits may be subject to an employee contribution.

Some benefits may be fully or partially subsidized. Incentive plans are linked to the nature of your employment and can vary based on region, market, function or brand.

Be a Part of Our Culture

BE Fearless

We empower our teams to question, challenge and innovate.

This means adopting an agile mindset, being comfortable with trying new things and taking risks, without being reckless.

BEHAVE LIKE Family

We treat each other, and our communities, like family. Always.

We are all ‘Primos’ (Spanish for cousins) at Bacardi. Being part of the family gives you the support you need to be the best you can be.

The spirit of entrepreneurship is at the heart of everything we do.

Everyone at Bacardi sees this business as their own. We do the right thing for the business and take accountability for our work.

Life Inside Bacardi

Be Fearless, act like a Founder.

Follow our Primos on their journey to success. Where did they start and what’s it like to work for Bacardi? You too can be part of our story.

Bacardi is the world's largest privately-held international spirits company. We are a brand-led growth company with over 200 brands and labels. More than 8,000 people across the globe work toward a common purpose to Make Moments Matter. At Bacardi we are guided by our 3Fs culture of being Fearless, treating each other like Family, and having a Founders mentality. And have plenty of fun along the way!

You will hear us refer to each other as a “Primo” which means cousin in Spanish, and it´s our way to referring to employees. It´s also a reminder that we are a family-owned business with Latin heritage since 1862.

Primos are empowered to embrace diversity of thought and a global mindset to grow the Bacardi business and be future fit.

Leadership at Bacardi listen to Primos through pulse surveys, town halls, action team forums and development training sessions.

We get to enjoy social events, brand days, celebrate in trade with customers and have the opportunity to give back to the community through local initiatives like My Inspirit Day. We stand by doing the right thing and foster a culture of wellness and prioritizing Primo wellbeing through impactful resources and initiatives.

If this sounds like a culture you wish to join, check out our current opportunities.

How can I stay on top of the latest Bacardi news?

Our Global headquarters is based in Bermuda. Our Regional headquarters are Amsterdam for Europe & Latin America & the Caribbean; Dubai for Asia, Middle East & Africa and Coral Gables for North America. For Global Marketing, our teams are based in London, UK. In addition, we have offices, distilleries, production sites and brand homes around the world.

What careers are possible at Bacardi?

Our portfolio boasts more than 200 brands and labels and we sell in more than 160 markets. That global scale offers opportunities across functions and markets. From those who craft and produce our brands to those who market and sell them to everything in between.We also have opportunities across levels of experience from those who are starting their professional career (and are of local legal drinking age) to those who have decades of experience under their belt.

Does Bacardi run an Internship or Graduate program?

From time to time, we contract talent for specific functions and markets on a paid internship basis. We do not run a recurring global internship and rather allow markets and team to determine local needs and opportunities.

Does Bacardi offer training and development opportunities to grow your career?

We are there for the moments that matter in our Primos’ careers - the times they need to step outside of their comfort zone and grow. Whether that’s when they step through our doors as a new Primo, take on a new role, want to learn new skills and develop, or take that opportunity of a lifetime abroad to gain experiences across different cultures, functions, and markets.

We have world-class resources to support you every step of the way. From our Becoming Bacardi onboarding to global mentorship programs, mixology sessions, regular “lunch and learns” and coaching and development programs, there are many ways to expand your skills and opportunities. Learning never ends and that’s why we even continue development at the most senior levels with global programs at Harvard Business School and the University of Miami, among others.

Do I need to drink alcohol to work at Bacardi?

The simple answer is no candidates do not need to drink alcohol to be considered for a role. The Bacardi portfolio of products includes alcohol, low alcohol and no alcohol products. Bacardi promotes balanced, moderate drinking as part of a mindful lifestyle. The decision whether or not to drink alcohol is a personal one and we respect lifestyle choices.

What we value most is high performing talent with an ability to understand how to engage with our brand consumers and business partners.

We do, of course, only hire people who are of legal drinking age in their market.

Does Bacardi run an Internship or Graduate program?

From time to time, we contract talent for specific functions and markets on a paid internship basis. We do not run a recurring global internship and rather allow markets and team to determine local needs and opportunities.

What language should I submit my application in?

English is the official and primary language at Bacardi. Our Hiring Teams are located worldwide. Please submit your resume and other materials in English. Only consider using a local language for your application if the job positing specifies this request.

What are the stages of an interview process?

The first step is submitting your application which will be reviewed by our Hiring Team. Should your experience meet the qualifications and expectations of the open role, you will begin the interview process. Generally speaking, you can expect a few stages of conversations. The timing of the interview process will vary and our focus will be on ensuring that the key stakeholders get to know you and that you get to know us. You will be expected to do a face-to-face interview in person or over video call in some cases, at least once, during the hiring process.
Sometimes we do ask candidates for customer facing roles or more junior candidates to complete an automated online video interview. You will self-record answers to our automated questions and this will be reviewed by the Hiring Team.

For Management and Leadership roles we may request an additional assessment that takes a deeper dive into your potential leadership style.

If your hiring journey is successful, we'll make it official with a job offer letter and be ready to welcome you to the team.

How long does the interview process take?

The process will vary and usually depend on different factors such as the volume of applications received, seniority level of the role and stakeholder availability within the hiring team. title: OPERADOR (A) CARBONIZACAO I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Oportunidade: Conduzir o processo de carbonização, controlando a entrada de oxigênio no forno visando a condução ideal do processo, de acordo com os procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos.

  • Vedar as portas dos fornos para eliminar entrada de oxigênio durante o processo de carbonização;
  • Dar ignição nos fornos, conforme procedimentos operacionais, para iniciar o processo de carbonização da madeira no forno;
  • Coletar dados referentes ao processo de carbonização através dos romaneios e repassar à liderança;

Residir em Corinto.

Ensino médio completo.

description:
Technology Service Representative - Technical Relationship Manager

Location: Sao Paulo

Business Area: Sales and Client Service

Ref #:

Description & Requirements

Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered.

Due to rapid business growth, we're expanding our team. In capital markets, both buy-side and sell-side firms aim to automate and streamline operations across asset classes - and Bloomberg is a key partner in making that happen. Our Enterprise Technology Services team plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability and performance of Bloomberg's products, as well as the custom integration solutions our clients rely on. Financial firms operate with dozens of interconnected systems to manage trading, evaluate risk, track P&L, and ensure timely settlement. But integrating these systems is complex, costly, and time-consuming. That's where we come in. Enterprise Technology helps clients simplify this complexity. We provide trusted tools, technical expertise, and seamless connectivity that reduce costs, accelerate implementation, and improve transparency. With our deep understanding of capital markets and track record delivering hosted solutions, Bloomberg is uniquely positioned to support our clients' integration strategies.

What's the Role?

  • As an Enterprise Technology Service Representative / Technical Relationship Manager, you'll be a key point of contact for our South American client base. You'll work alongside our global team to support and grow our business by delivering technical application support and integration expertise.
  • Based in-region, you'll partner with Pre-Sales to engage prospective clients and demonstrate Bloomberg's value. About the job Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer (SWE) goes way beyond just Search. SWE Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a SWE Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. SWE teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.
Come join our team as we help advance Access Security and reduce Insider Risk across Google by building and scaling a broad set of access infrastructure technologies including Access Security AI Agents, HttpSp (go/ NUAC (go/nuac), Tool Proxy (go/tool-proxy) and Unshelled (go/unshelled), support the growing number of our existing users and build brand new AI-based scenarios. Our architecture goes throughout the back-end stack, including storage, micro services, AI Agents and interfaces. We closely partner with multiple teams in ASI, Core, Cloud and other Product Areas, including UI, UX and Technical Writers.
In this role, you will contribute as a people manager, techinical leader and drive impactful architectural decisions, work with a wide network of partner teams, and stay on the AI technology.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

  • Identify and mitigate technical, resourcing and scheduling risks in close collaboration with the other leaders and stakeholders.

description:
Company Overview


Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do


Are you interested in sales compensation for a SaaS based company? The Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst will support the Global Sales Compensation Team in SPIFFs and plan distribution. This role will help effectively help with the set up of the SPIFF incentive structure and evaluation to drive accountability and program impact while also maintaining our comp plan distributions. The Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst will be a key member of the Plan Design & Strategy Sales Compensation team.

The ideal candidate is self-sufficient and a team player who constantly strives to scale and improve on processes, has an eye for details with accuracy, and is an excellent communicator. As an out of the box thinker, you will be rolling-up your sleeves and willing to take on any challenges.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Director, Sales Compensation Strategy.

Responsibility

  • Manage the end-to-end process of SPIFF administration, including pay implementation and calculation

  • Conduct detailed reporting and analysis on SPIFF program performance, including tracking sales metrics, evaluating ROI, and identifying trends, to inform strategic decision-making

  • Have knowledge of Sales Compensation policies and their application(s) to ensure compliance with the SPIFF program requirements

  • Create SPIFF enablement content for the Sales Organization

  • Co-lead the end-to-end process to launch and audit Sales Compensation Plans for monthly and annual distribution needed and identify gaps in process and policies

  • Maintain monthly reporting and ad hoc analysis

  • Support projects that assist sales enablement, SOX compliance, and systems integration

  • Build trust and relationships with the cross-functional team


Job Designation


Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring


Basic

  • BA/BS in a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in sales compensation and knowledge of incentive systems

Preferred

  • Experience in sales compensation in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Strong analytical skills, business acumen, and intellectual curiosity
  • Proven track record of gained efficiencies
  • Experience with Xactly or other Sales Incentive Compensation tools
  • Excellent organization, documentation, communication, and presentation skills
  • Proficient in Google Workspace
  • Results-driven and self-motivated with the ability to multitask
  • Effective, clear, and concise communication skills, verbal and written

Vem pro Souto Correa!

Nascemos em 2013 e hoje somos um escritório full-service reconhecido pelos principais rankings jurídicos globais, focado nas pessoas e proativo na promoção da diversidade no ambiente corporativo. No Souto Correa você encontrará um escritório com mais de 300 profissionais engajados para inovar em soluções jurídicas com foco no que importa.

De caráter multidisciplinar e dedicada exclusivamente às causas empresariais, a prática trabalhista engloba a atuação na gestão de contenciosos judiciais e administrativos, com estrutura para administrar, em todo o território nacional, ações trabalhistas ordinárias e estratégicas, tais como reclamatórias movidas por executivos, ações civis públicas, ações coletivas ajuizadas por entidades sindicais, ações indenizatórias decorrentes de acidentes de trabalho, doenças ocupacionais e procedimentos arbitrais.

Nossa equipe conduz a defesa de empresas em procedimentos administrativos promovidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho (MPT), a exemplo de procedimentos preparatórios, inquéritos civis e acompanhamento de TACs, assim como em fiscalizações do Ministério do Trabalho e Previdência sobre os mais variados temas, como reserva de vagas para pessoas com deficiência ou aprendizes, assédio moral, terceirização, dispensas coletivas e jornada de trabalho.

Na área consultiva, o time atua com foco na correção e melhoria de práticas e políticas internas, propondo soluções criativas para alinhar os interesses e estratégias dos clientes à legislação brasileira. A equipe é especializada na revisão de práticas trabalhistas para adequação das rotinas da empresa ao eSocial, à LGPD, revisão de passivos trabalhistas,due diligences em operações de fusão e aquisição (M&A), revisão e redação de contratos, políticas e códigos de conduta, assessoramento na contratação de empregados estrangeiros, expatriação, implementação de modelos de trabalho híbrido e remoto, estruturação de remuneração e benefícios, formas alternativas de contratação e treinamentosin company sobre direito do trabalho.

A atuação inclui a administração de relacionamento com sindicatos e negociações coletivas sobre os mais variados temas, tais como turnos de trabalho, compensação de jornada, participação nos lucros e dispensas coletivas.

  • Atuação em ações judiciais e administrativas para clientes nacionais e multinacionais, inclusive em demandas de alta complexidade;
  • Elaboração/revisão de contratos de trabalho, políticas internas, memorandos e pareceres sobre assuntos diversos, bem como revisão de práticas trabalhistas;
  • Possibilidade de atuação junto aos grupos de Proteção de Dados, Startup Hub, ESG e Relações Sindicais e Negociações Coletivas.

  • Experiência na área trabalhista com atividades de consultivo e contencioso estratégico.

AMA - E - O Ambulatório de Especialidades, unidade da Secretaria Municipal de Saúde de São Paulo gerenciada em parceria com a SPDM/PAIS, tem como finalidade atender às demandas encaminhadas pela Unidade Básica de Saúde (UBS) em especialidades, como: Cardiologia, Homeopatia, Neurologia, Ortopedia, Oftalmologia, Otorrino, Cirurgia Geral, Pneumologia, Angiologia, Dermatologia, Ginecologia e Gastroenterologia.

HOSPITAL DIA - Rede Hora Certatrata-se de uma Unidade que oferece serviços de atendimento médico especializado, exames de apoio diagnóstico e cirurgias eletivas que não demandem internação.

O Hospital Dia tem como objetivo ampliar o atendimento à população às Especialidades, garantindo a qualidade e a resolutividade do acompanhamento em saúde, otimizando o atendimento a demandas cirúrgicas de baixa complexidade e reduzindo o tempo e a fila de espera.

O agendamento das ações ofertadas ocorre de forma regulada, conforme a necessidade da região, e o paciente deve ser referenciado a partir da avaliação da Unidade Básica de Saúde.



Main responsibilities

Realizar atendimento médico dentro da especialidade de gastrenterologia, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde de São Paulo e protocolos existentes. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, através da regulação do acesso, de modo a otimizar a utilização dos recursos e promover a integralidade do cuidado.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina / Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Gastrenterologia / Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe / Experiência comprovada como Médico Gastroenterologista.

title: Head of Public Policy, Latin America
description:
Head of Public Policy, Latin America - removed

Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America. This role can be resident in Sao Paulo or Brasilia and will report to the Head of Americas Public Policy.

What you will do

Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;

Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;

Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;

Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;

Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;

Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;

Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;

Coordinate and drive compelling returns from the company’s partnerships with non-profits and civil society organizations; and

Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

What you should have

Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy

Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus

Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region

Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online

Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space

Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences

Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company

Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

EventMobi is an award-winning tech scale-up with thousands of clients across the globe. We believe that live events bring people together to enable change, for businesses and society at large.   • Utilizing Redux and dynamic reducers
  • React based page builder that generates React components with API integration
  • Adding more engagement features (chat/group discussions/1:1 video meetings/breakout rooms)

  • 3+ years experience working with JavaScript / Typescript and a deep understanding of the React ecosystem

  • Comfortable working with large code bases

  • Proficient using JSX / ES2020 + HTML / CSS

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Compensation: Base salary ranges from $55k to $65k CAD depending on experience

  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone that has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact of caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Porche and Shoppers Drug Mart, to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.
